hero.title: Automate Archicad with Ease.
hero.description: <0>From the users, to the community.</0> Tapir is an open-source bridge connecting Archicad to the modern development ecosystem (Python, Grasshopper, and AI) without requiring deep C++ knowledge. Unleash incredible time-saving workflows, generate complex geometries, and integrate your BIM models directly with AI.

architecture.title: Architecture & History
architecture.subtitle: How Tapir works under the hood and how it evolved.
architecture.systemDesc: Tapir is built on a robust C++ foundation that exposes Archicad's internal capabilities as an accessible JSON API. This allows multiple different ecosystems to interface with Archicad seamlessly.

phases.title: The JSON API Foundation
phases.desc: Tapir was born out of a need to bypass C++ complexity. The first major milestone was building the C++ Add-On to expose Archicad's core functions as a simple, stateless JSON API.

phases.title: Grasshopper Integration
phases.desc: To bring the power of Tapir to designers, the team developed the Grasshopper plugin, allowing visual programmers to manipulate Archicad elements parametrically.

phases.title: Community & Python
phases.desc: The project went fully open-source. A vibrant Discord community emerged, with dozens of contributors building and sharing their own Python automation scripts globally.

phases.title: The AI Era (Current)
phases.desc: The introduction of the Tapir MCP server enabled AI models like Claude to autonomously interact with Archicad, opening a new frontier of natural-language automation.

about.title: Why Tapir?
about.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the project.

cards.title: Incredibly Simple
cards.desc: Getting started is easy. Tapir wraps complex C++ APIs into an accessible, developer-friendly JSON and Python interface.

cards.title: AI-Ready
cards.desc: Designed for the future. With the new Tapir MCP, your AI assistants can interact directly with your Archicad models.

cards.title: Blazing Fast Development
cards.desc: The open-source project is accelerating rapidly, with continuous contributions pushing the boundaries of AEC automation.

learning.title: Learn & Build
learning.subtitle: Everything you need to master Archicad automation, from video guides to AI scripting.
learning.videoDesc: Prefer visual learning? Check out our comprehensive YouTube playlist covering everything from installation to building your first automation scripts.
learning.claudeDesc1: The Tapir community is heavily utilizing AI models like Claude to generate complex scripts on the fly. Many users with zero prior coding experience are building tailored tools for their offices every single day.
learning.claudeDesc2: Simply explain what you want to achieve in Archicad, share the Tapir command list, and let Claude write the Python code for you. If an error occurs, just paste the traceback back into Claude, and it will fix it immediately.

marketplace.title: Tapir Marketplace
marketplace.subtitle: A place to find and share Tapir scripts and Archicad add-ons, built for the community and free to use.
marketplace.bullet1: <0>No account needed:</0> Search, filter by category or Archicad version, and download instantly.
marketplace.bullet2: <0>Community Voting:</0> Vote for what you find useful to help the best scripts surface.
marketplace.bullet3: <0>Safe Downloads:</0> Every download is fingerprinted and re-checked every hour for changes.
marketplace.publishDesc1: Publishing needs a free GitHub account. Fill in one form: name, description, category, and a download link. Automated checks run and your listing goes live, usually within a couple of minutes.
marketplace.publishDesc2: <0>Your listing stays yours.</0> It is filed under your own GitHub name. You can edit or remove it whenever you like.
marketplace.publishDesc3: <0>Support the Creators.</0> Scripts can be free, free with a contribution link, or paid. In every case, you pay the author directly through their own link. The site never handles a payment or takes a cut.

roadmap.title: What's Cooking?
roadmap.subtitle: The 12 most anticipated features and ideas driving the next versions of Tapir.

items.title: Complex Hierarchical Elements
items.desc: Full support for reading and writing Stairs, Roofs, and Curtain Walls.

items.title: Cloud & Headless Execution
items.desc: Support for server-side automation running Archicad in headless mode.

items.title: Autonomous AI Drafting
items.desc: Deeper integration with AI agents for autonomous drafting and modeling tasks.

items.title: Real-time Event Listeners
items.desc: Enhanced API hooks to trigger scripts instantly when elements change.

items.title: Database Bi-directional Sync
items.desc: Seamless syncing of model properties with external databases like SQL or Airtable.

items.title: Material & Composite Editing
items.desc: Expanded capabilities to modify building materials and composites directly via API.

items.title: Custom Add-on UI Generation
items.desc: Built-in tools for creating custom Archicad dialogues using simple Python scripts.

items.title: 2D Detailing Automation
items.desc: Better handling of 2D lines, fills, and text for automated detailing.

items.title: Dynamic User Properties
items.desc: Support for injecting custom user-defined properties at runtime.

items.title: Pre-built Python Recipes
items.desc: An expanded community ecosystem of plug-and-play Python automation scripts.

items.title: Advanced Error Handling
items.desc: Improved Python tracebacks and API error messages for easier script troubleshooting.

items.title: Direct CI/CD Integration
items.desc: Seamless workflows for running automated Tapir scripts in GitHub Actions pipelines.

stats.title: Community & Momentum
stats.subtitle: Tapir is powered by an accelerating open-source community across GitHub and Discord.
stats.momentumDesc1: Development speed has accelerated massively over the past year. With <0>314 active Issues, Pull Requests, and Discussions</0> currently tracked, and <1>29 unique code contributors</1> submitting patches, the ecosystem is growing faster than ever. The community discord has become a vibrant hub for testing new workflows, reporting bugs, and suggesting incredible ideas for Archicad automation.
stats.momentumDesc2: Whether it's bridging the gap with Grasshopper or building LLM agents with the new <0>Tapir MCP</0>, the community is consistently pushing the envelope of what's possible in AEC.
